definitions.explanation: An entertainment venue featuring coin-operated video games, crane games, and other arcade machines.

examples.japanese: {放課後|ほうかご}にゲーセンに{行|い}く。
examples.english: I go to the arcade after school.

examples.japanese: ゲーセンで{格闘|かくとう}ゲームをする。
examples.english: I play fighting games at the arcade.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}のゲーセンが{閉店|へいてん}した。
examples.english: The arcade in front of the station closed down.

examples.japanese: ゲーセンでクレーンゲームに{挑戦|ちょうせん}した。
examples.english: I tried the crane game at the arcade.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of ゲームセンター (game center).

FULL FORM:
ゲームセンター is the formal term; ゲーセン is the common casual abbreviation.

TYPES OF GAMES:
- {格闘|かくとう}ゲーム: fighting games
- {音|おと}ゲー ({音楽|おんがく}ゲーム): rhythm/music games
- クレーンゲーム / UFOキャッチャー: crane games
- メダルゲーム: medal games (token-based arcade games)
- プリクラ: photo sticker booths

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ゲーセンに{行|い}く: go to the arcade
- ゲーセンで{遊|あそ}ぶ: play at the arcade
- ゲーセンに{通|かよ}う: frequent the arcade

CULTURAL NOTE:
Arcade culture has been significant in Japan, though the industry has been declining as home gaming has improved. Classic arcades featured competitive gaming communities, especially for fighting games.
